summary: Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K containing Q3 FY2026 results, which disclosed the completed divestiture of its banking operations in Colombia, Costa Rica, and Panama to Davivienda Group S.A. The sale closed on December 1, 2025, and the Bank received a 20.3% ownership interest in Davivienda, comprising 14.99% voting common shares and non-voting preferred shares, with no quoted market price for the common shares. The investment was recognized at fair value of $1,370 million due to significant influence via board representation. The filing notes an impairment loss related to the announced sale. This is a completed strategic divestiture with consideration in stock, representing a special situation.
